title: Writing --- My Own Line
label: ch:ru-own-line
canDo: I can write one line about myself by hand from a closed supply of known words, with nothing to copy, and check л, м, т and я before anything else.

payoff.summary: Complete RU-W258-own-line: я, a verb with its I-ending and the rest, chosen rather than copied, with the handwritten shapes checked first.
payoff.note: The first writing step with nothing to reach for. The Cyrillic-specific check arrives with it: copying always supplied the right shapes, so choosing your own words means choosing the shapes too -- л's point against м's dip, the bar over a handwritten т, and я facing away from Latin R.
